AVIATION — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket
